info.about: Wipeout 2048 is a 2012 racing video game developed by Studio Liverpool and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation Vita. The ninth instalment of the Wipeout series, it was a launch game for the console.
info.trivia: The last game from Studio Liverpool before Sony closed it in 2012.
info.why: A launch title, so supply is fine; the studio's closure and the Omega Collection port keep interest steady.
